input.title: Women's Swimming – Lap 47. I Think. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

LAP 47. I THINK. is the swimming hoodie for the lap swimmer who lost count somewhere around the third length, worn on the pool deck, on the walk to the locker room and as a gift from friends who have watched her float.

LAP 47. fills the top in tall condensed capitals and I THINK. fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a woman in a flowered rubber swim cap and round goggles floats in one pool lane with her arms folded behind her head, totally calm, with a striped lane rope beside her and small ripples around her.

Navy carries cream and pool aqua lettering with a cream edge around the pool scene; Sand gets deep teal and brick red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this swimming hoodie warm enough for pool decks and cool locker-room walks?
Yes. The Lap 47. I Think. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for pool decks, damp locker-room walks and cool mornings after a swim.

How does the Lap 47. I Think. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a lap swimmer?
It is a natural one. Every lap swimmer has lost count mid-set, so it lands with masters swimmers, swim-team parents and friends who wait on the pool deck. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the pool scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Lap 47. I Think. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
